description: .NET MAUI Windows deployment cannot find the generated `.appxrecipe` when Visual Studio targets the non-Windows framework, based on https://github.com/dotnet/maui/issues/16975.
prompt:
I upgraded my MAUI Blazor app to .NET 8 and F5 on Windows now stops before deployment. Clean/rebuild didn't help.

DEP1700: The recipe file `C:\Repos\mealboard\MealBoard\bin\Debug\net8.0-windows10.0.19041.0\win10-x64\MealBoard.build.appxrecipe` does not exist. You may need to build your project.
